columns.validationmsg: "Amount Transferred must be a valid amount"
columns.name: amttransfered

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	CashierShiftCode,
	OpenedOn,
	ClosedOn,
	OpenedBy,
	ClosedBy,
	ShiftOwner,
	ShiftStatus,
	CashAccCode,
	OpeningBalance,
	TotalAmount=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL(OpeningBalance,0) + 
		ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CSC.Qty * CSC.Denomination) FROM  CashierShiftCashCount CSC WHERE CSC.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(TotalAmount,0) END,
	AmtTransfered,
	AmtTransferedTo,
	AmtTransferedOn,
	Remarks,
	RefNo,
	CashSales=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SaleCatCode = 3 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CashSales,0) END,
	CreditSales=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.Amt - S.CashCharged) FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SaleCatCode <> 3 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CreditSales,0) END,
	CashSR=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT a=SUM(a)
		FROM
			(SELECT a=SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM SRLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SRCatCode = 8 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode 
			UNION ALL
			SELECT a=SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM SRBufferLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SRCatCode = 8 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode) T
		), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CashSR, 0) END,
	CreditSR=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.CashCharged) FROM SRLedger S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.SRCatCode <> 8 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CreditSR,0) END,
	CashService=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM ServiceHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceCatCode = 10 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CashService,0) END,
	CreditService=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.CashCharged) FROM ServiceHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceCatCode <> 10 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CreditService, 0) END,
	CashServiceReturn=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal) FROM ServiceRHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceRCatCode = 13 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CashServiceReturn,0) END,
	CreditServiceReturn=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(S.InvTotal - S.CashCharged) FROM ServiceRHeader S WHERE S.Posted='Y' AND S.Posted='Y' AND S.ServiceRCatCode <> 13 AND S.CashierShiftCode=CashierShift.CashierShiftCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.CreditServiceReturn,0) END,
	TotalReceipts=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.Debit) FROM GLDetail GD, GLHeader GL WHERE GL.Posted='Y' AND  GL.Date BETWEEN CashierShift.OpenedOn AND ISNULL(CashierShift.ClosedOn, GETDATE()) AND GL.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND GD.AccCode = CashierShift.CashAccCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.TotalReceipts,0) END,
	TotalPayments=CASE ShiftStatus WHEN 'O' THEN ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.Credit) FROM GLDetail GD, GLHeader GL WHERE GL.Posted='Y' AND  GL.Date BETWEEN CashierShift.OpenedOn AND ISNULL(CashierShift.ClosedOn, GETDATE()) AND GL.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND GD.AccCode = CashierShift.CashAccCode), 0) ELSE ISNULL(CashierShift.TotalPayments,0) END,
	NetAmt= CashierShift.NetAmt,
	DiffAmt = CashierShift.DiffAmt,
	CashierShift.DiffTransferedTo
FROM 
	CashierShift
WHERE 
	CashierShiftCode=:ai_code
